idea-plugin.name: Branch Health Dashboard
idea-plugin.description:
Branch Health Dashboard

Monitors the health of Git branches in your repository: age, activity, merge conflict potential, stale branch detection, and rebase vs merge recommendations.

Features

  • Branch health scoring — 0-100 health score with HEALTHY/AGING/STALE/DEAD levels
  • Age tracking — identifies stale branches with configurable thresholds
  • Activity analysis — commits per time period and activity trends
  • Conflict prediction — finds common changed files across branches (Pro)
  • Rebase advisor — recommends rebase vs merge based on divergence (Pro)
  • Cleanup actions — delete stale branches with confirmation (Pro)
  • Notifications — stale branch warnings and conflict risk alerts

Free vs Pro

  • Free: health score, age tracking, activity analysis (max 5 branches)
  • Pro: unlimited branches, conflict prediction, rebase advisor, cleanup automation

action.description: Scan all branches and calculate health scores
